description: This file implements TLS credential handling for gRPC in Go, including TLS connection info, handshake procedures, certificate validation, and security info retrieval.

classes.name: TLSInfo
classes.description: Contains authentication info for a TLS connection, including connection state and SPIFFE ID.

classes.name: tlsCreds
classes.description: Implements transport credentials for TLS, including handshake and configuration management.

classes.name: TLSChannelzSecurityValue
classes.description: Represents security details like cipher suite and certificates for channel security info.

methods.name: AuthType
methods.description: Returns the string 'tls' indicating the auth type.

methods.name: ValidateAuthority
methods.description: Validates the authority against peer certificates.

methods.name: GetSecurityValue
methods.description: Returns security info such as cipher suite and certificates.

methods.name: Info
methods.description: Returns protocol info including security protocol and version.

methods.name: ClientHandshake
methods.description: Performs TLS client handshake, returning connection and auth info.

methods.name: ServerHandshake
methods.description: Performs TLS server handshake, returning connection and auth info.

methods.name: OverrideServerName
methods.description: Overrides the server name in TLS config.

methods.name: NewTLS
methods.description: Constructs TLS transport credentials from a tls.Config.

methods.name: applyDefaults
methods.description: Applies default settings to a tls.Config, such as minimum version and cipher suites.

methods.name: NewClientTLSFromCert
methods.description: Creates TLS credentials from a root CA pool with optional server name override.

methods.name: NewClientTLSFromFile
methods.description: Creates TLS credentials from CA certificate file with optional server name override.

methods.name: NewServerTLSFromCert
methods.description: Creates server TLS credentials from a certificate.

methods.name: NewServerTLSFromFile
methods.description: Creates server TLS credentials from certificate and key files.
